purpose: 기존 CNN·STT 결과로 입력별 결합 가능성과 같은 사람 분할의 고정 결합 대비 효과 확인
high_group: person mean true GDI >= 90; evaluation analysis only
possibility_screen: inner held-out-base record-wise oracle MAE at least 0.1 point below matched fixed combination; oracle uses labels and is not deployable performance
selection: each base-held-out inner fold split into meta train/select/audit people; select lambda and constant fallback using select MAE only; report audit separately; freeze choices then refit on the entire base-held-out inner fold
evaluation: each f,j base excludes outer f and meta j; apply each gate to same f,j outer predictions then average four paths; no cross-path feature pooling for meta selection
primary: internally selected family with constant fallback versus matched fixed prediction; paired person MAE and fold changes; no adoption based solely on one positive metric
limitations: inner base models use fixed final epochs
different prediction route from legacy refit and bagged best
model disagreement/spread are proxies, not verified joint tracking accuracy
no new base neural network training
no protected final cohort or external normal data
